title: Advanced DLP Private Service Edge for EDM and IDM

complementary-role.statement: The Advanced DLP Private Service Edge is a complementary, dedicated hardware role within the Zscaler cloud that provides on-premises support for Private Service Edge customers who also need Advanced DLP features such as Exact Data Match (EDM) and Indexed Data Match (IDM).

quotes: is a complementary, dedicated hardware role within the Zscaler cloud that can be deployed to provide on-premises support for Private Service Edge customers who also require Advanced DLP product features, such as Exact Data Match (EDM) and Indexed Data Match (IDM).

alongside-standard-cluster.statement: An Advanced DLP Private Service Edge cluster must be deployed alongside a standard Private Service Edge cluster; it is installed in tandem with standard Private Service Edges and dedicated to the organization's EDM and IDM workload traffic.

quotes: An Advanced DLP Private Service Edge cluster must be deployed alongside a standard Private Service Edge cluster.

traffic-path.statement: Customer proxy traffic is still directed to the standard Private Service Edge cluster VIP addresses; if required, that cluster forwards the traffic to the Advanced DLP Private Service Edge cluster for additional processing, evaluation and trigger response.

quotes: All proxy traffic forwarded by the customer is still directed toward the standard Private Service Edge cluster VIP addresses.
If required, the Private Service Edge cluster then forwards the traffic to the Advanced DLP Private Service Edge cluster for additional processing, evaluation, and trigger response.

block-trigger.statement: If the Advanced DLP evaluation returns a block trigger, the packet flow stops at that point and the outbound traffic is blocked.

quotes: If the DLP evaluation returns a ‘block’ trigger, the packet flow stops here and the outbound traffic is blocked.
evidence.after: Advanced DLP Private Service Edge 5 (Dedicated LB) & Private Service Edge 5 (Dedicated LB)

models-and-footprint.statement: The description table lists two models: Advanced DLP Private Service Edge 3 (3 instances, integrated LB, 1GE, sized for 1 Gbps download) and Advanced DLP Private Service Edge 5 (5 instances, integrated LB, 10GE, sized for 2 Gbps download); the sizing tables also include a Private Service Edge 5 with Dedicated LB (6 instances, up to 4 LBs, 2 to 4 Advanced DLP Private Service Edges per cluster). The cluster is typically a 1:1 match with the standard Private Service Edge cluster footprint, with a minimum of two servers and no standalone deployment.

quotes: | Advanced DLP Private Service Edge 3 | An annual subscription to Advanced DLP Private Service Edge with 3 Advanced DLP Service Edge instances, an integrated load balancer, and a 1 GE network interface. | 1 Gbps |

| Advanced DLP Private Service Edge 5 | An annual subscription to Advanced DLP Private Service Edge with 5 Advanced DLP Service Edge instances, an integrated load balancer, and a 10 GE network interface. | 2 Gbps |
| Number of Advanced DLP Service Edge Instances | 3 | 5 | 6 |
| Number of Load Balancers | 1 | 1 | Up to 4 |
| Advanced DLP Private Service Edge per Cluster | 2 | 2 | 2–4 |
The Advanced DLP Private Service Edge cluster is typically a 1:1 match with the Private Service Edge cluster footprint.
Zscaler does not support standalone Private Service Edge deployments of any kind.

ipv4-only.statement: Advanced DLP Private Service Edge addresses are public IPv4 only; with RFC 1918 addressing and NAT they must have 1:1 static NAT to a public IPv4 address.

quotes: All the IP addresses needed must be public IPv4 addresses only.

placement.statement: An Advanced DLP Private Service Edge cluster can be deployed wherever the standard cluster resides: inside the DMZ (recommended), outside the corporate firewall, or behind the network firewall (which requires Zscaler approval). Behind a firewall or ACL device, the rules published at config.Zscaler.com/<Zscaler Cloud Name>/zia-private-dlp apply.

quotes: - Behind the network firewall (This deployment method requires approval from Zscaler)
you must implement rules found on config.Zscaler.com/<Zscaler Cloud Name>/zia-private-dlp.

requires-standard-cluster.statement: The Advanced DLP Private Service Edge cluster is not deployable on its own: it must be deployed alongside a standard Private Service Edge cluster.
requires-standard-cluster.conditions: Follows from the 'must be deployed alongside' wording; it says nothing about whether EDM or IDM is available to a tenant by other means.
